## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and before/after behavior.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their outcomes. Link fictional-data captures if the interface changed. State browser/environment limits.

## Review checks

- [ ] No personal data, secrets, generated builds or private traces included.
- [ ] Matching changes include a meaningful development regression case and measured evaluation.
- [ ] Permission, privacy and compatibility documentation matches the change.
- [ ] Existing-value protection, explicit review and safe undo remain intact.
